name: goat-grid-explainer
description: Grid Explainer · Торон дэвтэр: turns a talking-head clip into a light step-by-step app demo on grid paper. The face shrinks into a white-framed card, a blue rail tags each chapter, a headline marks one keyword in a dashed selection box, and small app cards act out each point; the face grows back to full screen between points. Cuts the pauses, built on HyperFrames. Renders a 1080x1920 MP4 for Reels/TikTok.
